evidence: The MeCpPtMe3 was heated to 30 °C and dosed into the deposition chamber by using Ar as carrier gas. Note that a carrier gas was used in contrast to previous work, 11 because this leads to more reproducible precursor dosing. An Ar purge step and a pump step (3 s each) directly after the MeCpPtMe3 pulse ensured that the reaction products and excessive precursor were evacuated from the chamber before pulsing the reactant.
